ai_summary: Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals reported a robust H1 FY27, showcasing significant revenue (+22.9%), EBITDA (+65.3%), and PAT (+100.7%) growth driven by its core CDMO business and expanded margins. Strategically, the company is focusing on international expansion with a substantial European CDMO contract and a Zambian manufacturing JV, alongside diversifying into nutraceuticals and cosmetics. However, a material red flag is the 25.4% PAT decline in FY26, alongside a reported reduction in sales for underperforming API and Trade Generics segments to minimize losses, indicating past profitability challenges in certain areas requiring careful execution of its ambitious growth strategies.
